description: Registry of capability claims that may appear on PeerStatusView. Tier-1 capabilities have typed sibling fields on peer-status-view; Tier-2 capabilities live in the extensions map. Promotion criteria (Tier 2 → Tier 1) require two-or-more of: substrate-wide matchmaking branches on the claim, validators enforce structural constraints on the claim, multi-app consumption (3+ apps), or cross-pillar accountability flows. Documented in genesis/docs/superpowers/specs/2026-05-08-ssr-capability-design.md.

_source.owner: protocol — registry curation lives in this repo via PR
_source.rationale: Documentation + collision-avoidance for capability namespaces. Validators do not consult this at runtime; it gates schema design at PR review time.
